## Core Capabilities & Services

Zubair provides bespoke web development and frontend engineering services for clients in Faisalabad, Pakistan, and internationally:

- **React & Next.js Web Application Development** — React 19, Next.js 15 App Router, Server Actions, hooks, Redux Toolkit, React Router.
- **Next.js Performance Optimization** — Core Web Vitals remediation (LCP, INP, CLS), edge caching, ISR, and image/font pipelines.
- **Interactive 3D & Creative Web Development** — Three.js canvas integration, WebGL/WebGPU shaders, smooth scrolling with Lenis, GSAP scroll-triggered timelines, Framer Motion.
- **Headless E-commerce Frontend Development** — Modern, blazing-fast product catalogs, cart flows, checkout interfaces.
- **UI/UX Design & Prototyping** — Clean aesthetic typography, dark mode, glassmorphism, micro-interactions, responsive Figma-to-code implementations.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React 19, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Next.js 15, Redux Toolkit, Vite
- **Motion & 3D:** Three.js, GSAP (GreenSock), Framer Motion, Lenis Smooth Scroll, Spline 3D
- **Backend & Tooling:** Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Git, GitHub, ESLint, Netlify
